transport.note: The HTTP composition is a library export for the hosted SESS runtime to compose with its own authentication and durable handle store. This package ships no HTTP server, bin flag, OAuth server or deployment; no remote endpoint or host is qualified by this record.

mcpLibrary.name: @modelcontextprotocol/server
mcpLibrary.serverApi: low-level Server (request handlers). stdio: Server.connect(StdioServerTransport) through the raw-message unsafe-key guard, a 2025-era connection exactly as before. HTTP: createMcpHandler with its default legacy: 'stateless' fallback, one server instance per request.

previous.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
previous.note: Runtime dependency until this change; now a devDependency used only as the declared-legacy test client.

stdio.note: Unchanged on the wire: raw initialize, tools/list (five tools, sess-mcp-tools/2), tool errors, unknown-tool error, unsafe-key and unknown-property rejections, server/discover (method not found), ping and stderr diagnostics are byte-identical to the 1.32.1 build. One SDK-level difference: a tools/call whose arguments is not an object was -32603 and is now -32602 Invalid params. Since the Q-2 annotation audit (2026-10-15), tools/list differs from that build in one tool hint: sess_complete has destructiveHint true (was false); titles, descriptions, schemas and sess-mcp-tools/2 are unchanged.

http.note: One endpoint serves both eras: per-request 2026-07-28 traffic and the stateless legacy fallback (initialize answered with 2025-11-25, no session ID).

protocol.offered: Only the tools capability. No Tasks, Apps, elicitation, sampling, resources or prompts; the human step never depends on elicitation.
